incidents.summary: Kier pleaded guilty to safety breaches and was fined £4.4 million in 2023 after its workers twice brought down overhead powerlines on an M6 project in 2018 and 2019.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: Kier workers operating machinery on a project on the M6 motorway near Sandbach, Cheshire twice brought down overhead powerlines, in incidents in March 2018 and January 2019.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: In January 2023, the company was fined £4.4m after pleading guilty to safety breaches at Manchester Crown Court.

incidents.summary: Kier subscribed to an illegal construction-industry blacklist and received an ICO enforcement notice, with related legal proceedings subsequently announced in 2017.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: Kier was revealed as a subscriber to the UK's Consulting Association, exposed in 2009 for operating an illegal construction industry blacklist, and was among 14 issued with enforcement notices by the UK Information Commissioner's Office.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: Subsequently, Kier was among eight businesses involved in the 2014 launch of the Construction Workers Compensation Scheme, condemned as a "PR stunt" by the GMB union, and described by the Scottish Affairs Select Committee as "an act of bad faith".

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: Unite also said it was taking action against 12 major contractors including Kier.

incidents.summary: Kier was identified for late supplier payments and subsequently suspended from the Prompt Payment Code, with the listed businesses reinstated during 2019 and 2020.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: In October 2018, Kier was named as a 'poor payer' at a Parliamentary inquiry into small businesses, failing to pay 48% of invoices due within their agreed terms, leading some suppliers to refuse to work for the company.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: In November 2019, Kier and subsidiary McNicholas Construction Services were suspended from the Prompt Payment Code for "failing to honour a commitment to pay 95% of all supplier invoices within 60 days".

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: Kier Integrated Services was reinstated in August 2020, but McNicholas Construction Services remained suspended until December 2020.

incidents.summary: England Highways alleged that Kier Highways overcharged third parties for road-damage costs and reported that Highways England held a draft KPMG investigation report.

sources.title: Attempts to keep KPMG's 'Project Verde' Report Secret - National Highways
sources.quote: Kier Highways profiteering from the privileged position in which Highways England had placed them; the overcharging of drivers, fleets, hauliers or their insurers (Third Parties).

sources.title: Attempts to keep KPMG's 'Project Verde' Report Secret - National Highways
sources.quote: it holds information namely (i) a draft report prepared by KPMG dated 31 January 2018 and (ii) correspondence between HE, KPMG and the contractor Kier Group in relation to this.

incidents.summary: Kier subsidiary McNicholas Construction was named for failing to pay £170,517.57 in legal minimum wages to 704 workers.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: In June 2023, Kier subsidiary McNicholas Construction was named for failing to pay staff the UK legal minimum wage.

sources.title: Kier Group
sources.quote: It was among the 10 worst offenders, failing to pay £170,517.57 to 704 workers.

incidents.summary: The FRC identified errors in Kier's 2017 accounts, including misclassification of a £40 million disposal gain and disposal proceeds.

sources.title: PwC fined £5m over Kier and Galliford Try audit jobs
sources.quote: These included errors in the income and cashflow statements of the Kier 2017 results, where a £40m gain on the disposal of Mouchel was wrongly disclosed within continuing operations rather than discontinued operations.

sources.title: PwC fined £5m over Kier and Galliford Try audit jobs
sources.quote: The FRC said this was “clearly inconsistent” with the reporting of Mouchel’s operating loss in discontinued operations.

sources.title: PwC fined £5m over Kier and Galliford Try audit jobs
sources.quote: Elsewhere, cash inflows from sales of Mouchel and another unidentified company were wrongly disclosed as operating cash, rather than investing cash.
